assumption_to_test: a compact policy, attestation, and assessment model can reproduce acceptance and rejection without live crypto verification
smallest_testable_validation: one exact item digest, one versioned trust policy, one attestation record, one fail-closed decision, and negative fixtures
expected_learning: whether trust inputs and verifier boundaries are sufficient for a v0.8.4 release
success_threshold: all positive validation and retained negative fixtures pass; mismatches cannot become trusted
